verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online documents custom workflows (Advanced), and a community user confirms built-in automatic rules for transaction categorization, so the product does ship user-defined automation. Automated payment reminders are a further example of event-driven action. The evidence is thin on what events can trigger rules and what actions they can take. Missing for 10: documentation of rule/workflow configuration (trigger events, conditions, action types), evidence of event-driven triggers beyond categorization and reminders, independent hands-on corroboration of workflow depth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
